verdict.rationale: Docs indicate the agent can run checks/tests, inspect diffs before merge, and even shipped a real changelog example of updating dependency version constraints (cursor-docs-4, cursor-docs-12, cursor-docs-13), supporting test-running and dependency-update use cases, but there is no explicit documentation of automated merge-conflict resolution or lint-error fixing as a named workflow. Missing for 10: explicit lint-fix workflow docs, explicit merge-conflict resolution example, and independent hands-on verification of these specific tasks succeeding.
